title: Member Accounts Note: Kestrel Care Rewards Relief from the Delivery Pass Reinstatement Fee (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
When a Delivery & Pickup Services plan settles an overdue cycle, the reinstatement relief depends on the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status together with the deliveries completed on the plan in the 12 months up to the settlement date.

## Relief

| Active Kestrel Care Rewards level | Deliveries completed on the plan in the 12 months up to the settlement date | Relief from the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 8 or more | 100 percent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 8 or more | 50 percent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum or Gold | 7 or fewer | none |
| any other level, or no active membership | any number | none |

The relief percentage acts on the reinstatement fee after that fee has been reduced to any cap that applies to it, and the reinstatement fee still due is rounded to the cent.

The deliveries counted are the orders recorded as delivered on the plan in the 12 months up to the settlement date; attempts that failed and orders cancelled or returned are not deliveries.

## Hypothetical cases

| Level | Deliveries in 12 months | Reinstatement fee as it stands before relief | Still due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 8 | $4.00 | $0.00 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 11 | $4.00 | $2.00 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 9 | $1.50 | $0.75 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 7 | $2.00 | $2.00 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 20 | $2.00 | $2.00 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 10 | $0.50 | $0.25 |
